rationale: This change strengthens existing permanent/trusted CI policy enforcement so every Current Host workflow and every workflow containing an explicit Current Host marker is automatically checked for immutable 40-hex GitHub Action pins. It does not change runtime execution, providers, runner selection, host-resource allocation, hardware behavior, proof recipes, evidence semantics, application behavior, or promotion authority. It prevents future workflow setup-policy regressions only; therefore no fresh physical Current Host requalification or FULL-525 replay is required.
